$comment: Seed agent identities for the demo. In the product an owner creates identities on the dashboard; this file seeds them. Format: a JSON object whose 'identities' array holds one entry per identity with 'handle' ('@<owner>/<name>'), 'owner' (an id from penguin/owners.json), 'vendor' (the agent product the identity runs in: 'claude-code' or 'codex'), 'job' (the work the identity does) and 'charter_scopes' (ids from penguin/scopes.json that the identity may change).

identities.job: Fix the daily ingestion batches so that events at one instant share a batch
Build a weekly activity report bucketed by each user's local day
Build reminder scheduling at each user's local hour
